## Problem
What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the feature you'd like.

## Accessibility Considerations
- How will this feature work with screen readers?
- What are the touch target requirements?
- Does it need keyboard-only navigation support?

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Target Users
- [ ] Wheelchair users
- [ ] Visually impaired users
- [ ] Elderly users
- [ ] Parents with strollers
- [ ] Caregivers
- [ ] Venue owners
- [ ] General public
